channel.title: CERT@VDE — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by CERT@VDE (certvde).

item.title: CVE-2026-110935 · 8.6 HIGH — Path traversal in plug-in deployment
item.description: The PFI plugin framework deployment routine does not validate path components when extracting archive entries to the local plugin repository. Archive entries containing relative path segments such as '..' are not rejected, allowing an unauthenticated…

item.title: CVE-2026-110022 · 8.6 HIGH — Signed plug-in validation bypass
item.description: The PFI plugin framework deploys executable assemblies (DLLs) from a signed plugin package into the local plugin repository and loads them via reflection, but the deployment routine processes archive entries that were never covered by the signature v…

item.title: CVE-2026-110021 · 6.9 MEDIUM — Missing GSDX SignatureValue verification
item.description: PLCnext Engineer checks GSDX manifest reference digests but does not cryptographically verify the XML `SignatureValue` over canonicalized `SignedInfo`. An unauthenticated local attacker can modify signed GSDML content, update its manifest digest, ret…

item.title: CVE-2026-109161 · 6.9 MEDIUM — Buffer Overflow in Digital I/O
item.description: Insufficient bounds checking in the Digital I/O function may allow a remote attacker with high privileges to cause a denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-105982 · 8.6 HIGH — Command Injection in IPsec VPN
item.description: Improper input validation in the IPsec VPN function may allow a remote attacker with high privileges to inject system commands and execute them with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-105981 · 8.6 HIGH — Command Injection in Digital I/O
item.description: Improper input validation in the Digital I/O function may allow a remote attacker with high privileges to inject operating system commands and execute them with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-105980 · 8.6 HIGH — Command Injection in WireGuard VPN
item.description: Improper input validation in the WireGuard VPN function may allow a remote attacker with high privileges to inject system commands and execute them with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-105979 · 8.6 HIGH — Command Injection in ZeroTier VPN

item.title: CVE-2026-105978 · 8.6 HIGH — Command Injection in Management Control Functions
item.description: Improper input validation in management control functions may allow a remote attacker with high privileges to inject operating system commands and execute them with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-107564 · 8.7 HIGH 🌩️ — gocsaf/csaf: csaf_provider prone to uncontrolled resource consumption
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker may use an allocation of resources without limits or throttling weakness in the affected product to cause high CPU load leading to a denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-94410 · 5.3 MEDIUM — Exposure of Role List to Low-Privileged Remote Users in Bender Custom&Partner Service
item.description: A low privileged remote attacker is able to view a list of roles that should only be accessible to administrators. This results in a low level of confidentiality breach, as no particularly sensitive information is affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-94293 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Missing authentication for critical function in the aas-edge-client REST API
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can modify Asset Administration Shell submodel data via PATCH requests and can read all data exposed by the GET endpoints.

item.title: CVE-2025-41753 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Path traversal in dynamically created BACnet File Objects
item.description: The object name of a dynamically created BACnet File Object is interpreted as a file path without sufficient validation. Because relative paths are not limited to the intended directory, an unauthenticated remote attacker can traverse outside of it a…

item.title: CVE-2026-76992 · 8.7 HIGH 🌩️ — Uncontrolled Memory Allocation in CODESYS Gateway Client
item.description: The CODESYS Gateway Client allocates memory based on a size field in a gateway response without enforcing an appropriate upper limit. An unauthenticated remote attacker controlling a malicious gateway can exploit this behavior to trigger excessive me…

item.title: CVE-2026-79625 · 8.1 HIGH — Improper Synchronization in Monitoring in CODESYS Control Runtime
item.description: Affected products do not properly synchronize access to their monitoring functionality. When multiple clients send concurrent requests, this may lead to incorrect reads or writes, or to corruption of internal memory structures. An authenticated remot…

item.title: CVE-2026-27565 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Remote code execution via uploading a malicious IODD file
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can upload a malicious IODD file that places and executes a shell script with root privileges. The shell script remains active even after a reboot.
